# Brenden Jarrett

> Brenden Jarrett is a game audio composer and sound designer who has been making music since 2017. He writes ambient electronic, IDM and instrumental electronic music, and composes soundtracks and designs sound for video games and film. He is open to scoring and sound design work on indie and studio game projects.

## Sound and influences

- Genres: ambient electronic, IDM (intelligent dance music), instrumental electronic, video game music.
- Electronic influences: Aphex Twin, Boards of Canada, Com Truise, Squarepusher.
- Game audio influences: Bungie's Halo and Marathon (Martin O'Donnell), Valve's Half-Life and Portal, Playdead's INSIDE (Martin Stig Andersen), The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (Jeremy Soule), and Koji Kondo.
- Favorite games (rated 5 stars): Balatro, Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Castle Crashers, Dead Space, Fable II, Fallout: New Vegas, Gears of War 2, Half-Life 2, Half-Life 2: Episode Two, Halo: Combat Evolved, Halo 2, Halo 3, Halo: Reach, Halo: The Master Chief Collection, Helldivers 2, Inside, Kirby Air Ride, Kirby Air Riders, Left 4 Dead 2, Lost Planet: Extreme Condition, Lost Planet 2, Marathon, Mario Kart World, Mass Effect 2, Portal, Red Dead Redemption, Skate 2, Star Wars: Battlefront II, Super Mario 64, Super Smash Bros., The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth II, The Orange Box, Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory, Wall Street Raider.
- Favorite films for score and sound (rated 5 stars): A Quiet Place, A Quiet Place Part II, Akira, Alien, Alien: Romulus, Aliens, Band of Brothers, Blade Runner, Blade Runner 2049, Casino Royale, Chernobyl, Dawn of the Planet of the Apes, District 9, Donnie Darko, Dune, Dune: Part Two, Edge of Tomorrow, Fight Club, Ford v Ferrari, Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga, Gladiator, Godzilla Minus One, Good Will Hunting, Inception, Interstellar, It's a Wonderful Life, John Wick: Chapter 4, Jurassic Park, Mad Max: Fury Road, Minority Report, Moneyball, My Neighbor Totoro, No Country for Old Men, No Half Measures: Creating the Final Season of Breaking Bad, Once Upon a Time in the West, Pan's Labyrinth, Ponyo, Prisoners, Project Hail Mary, Prometheus, Psycho, Raising Arizona, Sicario, Skyfall, Spirited Away, Stalker, Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith, Tenet, Terminator 2: Judgment Day, Terminator Salvation, The Bourne Ultimatum, The Dark Knight, The Empire Strikes Back, The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King, The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers, The Matrix, The Odyssey, The Prestige, The Shawshank Redemption, The Thing, There Will Be Blood, What About Bob?.
- Tools: Ableton Live (main DAW), Wwise (game audio middleware), Adobe Premiere Pro, Sequential Prophet-6, Korg Minilogue, EFNOTE drums, Ableton Push 2.

## Music

- [Music](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/): all releases, with track previews.
- [Quailentime](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/quailentime/) (album, 2026): synthesizers, piano, drum machines and guitars; loud and vivacious, then soft and ambient.
- [Grandpa's Clothes EP](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/grandpas-clothes-ep/) (EP, 2025): acoustic instruments coupled with synthesizers.
- [ACOLDAUS](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/acoldaus/) (album, 2024): a collection of lost, deleted and unfinished songs.
- [Cleft](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/cleft/) (album, 2023): astronomical, with large sweeping reverbs and experimental synthesizers.
- [Effervescent](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/effervescent/) (album, 2022): electronica in four segments: beats, ambience, piano and guitar.
- [Tomorrow Is Only a Dream Away](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/tomorrow-is-only-a-dream-away/) (single, 2018).
- Streaming: [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0vUuyq2k7Zz5etqPfTC1cY), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/artist/brenden-jarrett/1651731935), [Bandcamp](https://brendenjarrett.bandcamp.com/), [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com/channel/UCkjo_ITGxskD-G90v71qWeg).

## Writing on game audio

- [Balatro's Polyrhythmic & Polychrome Score](https://brendenjarrett.com/articles/balatros-polyrhythmic-and-polychrome/): LouisF's score for Balatro.
- [Going Outside the Norm by Scoring INSIDE a Real Human Skull](https://brendenjarrett.com/articles/going-outside-the-norm-by-scoring/): Martin Stig Andersen's sound for Playdead's INSIDE.
- [Skyrim Helps 903 of Us Sleep](https://brendenjarrett.com/articles/how-skyrims-score-has-cast-a-cathartic/): Jeremy Soule's score for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.
